semantic_contract: parse the userspace value with base 10 through kstrtouint_from_user
return -EINVAL on parse failure without logging or taking the mutex
normalize every successful input to boolean zero or one
take the mutex at tpd_cdev + 0xc60 and compare the stored state at tpd_cdev + 0x16
log the no-change branch without invoking a callback
on a transition, update +0x16 and invoke the optional callback at +0xe60 with value zero
preserve the inline stock KCFI literal 0x38d5b490 and release the mutex on every valid path

evidence.raw_difference: The compiler chose different registers for the previous-state comparison; the callback remains an inline KCFI-checked call, so no ordinary callback relocation is emitted. Local string relocations have generated offsets different from stock.

follow_up_required: Review register allocation only if exact opcode identity is required.
Keep the inline KCFI literal and callback slot under review when changing compiler/toolchain settings.
Run controlled procfs/userspace, concurrent callback, and NX809J runtime validation after the offline driver set is complete.
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, exact 69-instruction/276-byte AArch64 body, matching function KCFI, inline callback KCFI literal and offset contract, strict Joern with zero unresolved calls, reproducible Docker build, and four-case two-cycle ASan/UBSan host contract. No smartphone test was performed.
